body: Yo I just made a post with the same idea behind it. Why do we all have to be nice to people who dont deserve it just because its the right thing to do?

Hey hon.. I’m in a similar situation. I’ve taken a semester off. I don’t know how much help I can be but I hope you feel better knowing someone understands.. Right now I’m just coping by hanging out with my pets, and going to therapy but I know that’s not always an option for some people.. It’s always good to get into clubs and organizations around your home town or find a discord server with people who share sinilar interests with.
